generic_lessons: A single pcall scope is not a freshness recheck. A raw candidate can compile and produce syntactically complete output while asserting stale facts; independently mutate faith/context/list shape in isolated counterexamples.
Do not skip invalid demographic rows and still label the complete snapshot known. Dense unique bounded rows and full repeat comparison prevent partial truth being advertised as a complete baseline.

Owners must correct their input contracts too: Native UI reports unaffiliated citizens as Religion=-1 and retains zero-follower rows. An initial owner diagnostic rejected a valid native shape; retain that failure, qualify the actual data and add the observed case.
UI and Gameplay export different object ports: UI unit religion/charges are flat; Core uses GetReligion component. A native UI probe with GetReligion nil is not a product Core API failure.

An actor-free city can still convert by ordinary pressure. Missionary acceptance requires a causal chain including purchase receipt, actual unit, original operation, charge consumption and matched follower changes.
Record player diplomatic choices separately from final congress results; equal outcome labels can target another player or district. Do not credit TEST_PLAYER votes as background administration.
